limitations: This packet supplies finite-type semistable substacks for the retained semistable HN factor types.
Each substack is cut inside a finite-type bounded Quot/Postnikov ambient chart and has zero semistability and boundedness defects.
It does not construct derived enhancements, universal complexes, rigidifications, inertia strata, extension/flag stacks, cosection atlases, transitions, Pfaffian orientations, or protected traces.
